### Improved
- Much lighter in the tray: while the widget is hidden, WebView2 is told so and lets go of its memory. In Task Manager it drops from about 157 MB to about 30 MB, and CPU use to almost zero. The radio keeps playing.
- Lighter on screen too: the visualizer redraws 30 times a second while playing and 12 while paused (it was 60 all the time), and stops in logo mode. CPU use while playing went from about 22% of one core to about 3%.
